//Venom: THE ADDER'S VENOM (Documentation/Design/Harsh_Wilds_Content_Update_As_Built.md section 9): a hidden self-timed effect stat, the shape of hw_stat_bugswarm.json and the vanilla GarlicEffect. Its only writer is hw_event_adder's button, which adds +16 (ADDER_VENOM_TICKS, this stat's max) to it once; the base rate of -1 then drains it a tick at a time, so the venom lasts 16 ticks, four hours. While it reads 1 to 16 its one status is active and, as a status, carries a Pain ValueModifier of +30 (ADDER_VENOM_PAIN) and a Stress RateModifier of +1 a tick (ADDER_VENOM_STRESS), both removed by the game when the stat drains to 0. WHY A STATUS AND NOT AN ACTION WRITE: Pain (GUID ec5f330267076884dbe9cfdd2fd8503b, 0 to 500) has a base rate of 0 and nothing pulls it back, so an action's StatModifications on it would be PERMANENT (CLAUDE.md Food Items and EdibleStats Pattern); a status modifier is a GlobalModifier that ends with the status. +30 stays under Pain's first status band (100), so it hurts without reaching a band by itself. WHY NOT NAUSEA: Nausea caps at 24 and the vanilla Tgr_DizzyVomit fires on Nausea 20 to 24 (CLAUDE.md Perks, the StartingStatModifiers clamp paragraph), so this stat never names Nausea at all. Stress (GUID 3b79a4c6d7e151044a1c56fbbd401d78, 0 to 240, base rate -0.25) takes the +1 as a rate, so it climbs a net 0.75 a tick (about 12 over the venom). It NEVER alerts (NotifyPlayer 0, AlertLevel 0): the bite wound card is what the player sees. Visibility 2 is NeverVisible, as for the other hidden effect stats. All three numbers are TUNABLE PLACEHOLDERS, session-inferred and unmeasured against play.

Description.DefaultText: Hidden timer: how many ticks of adder venom are left.
The adder's venom burns in the bite and wears on your nerves.
